title: Find or generate slide backgrounds
description: Finds background images through the provider chain in providers.json (your own library first, then free stock, then generators) and reports which providers were tried. Input: query, optional count, orientation, provider; or generate: true with a prompt to create one image.
phrases: find a background for this slide
search background images for my carousel
look for stock photos for the carousel

safety.rule: Never publishes. Generators that bill per image only run when their key is set and the chain reaches them.
safety.notes: Calls only the providers you enabled and configured. Generated images are saved to the library folder in the data dir.
